name: John Spittal
description: LINZ Chief Topographer/Hydrographer at the 1999 digital topographic database milestone.
story: Land Information New Zealand's internal newsletter Landlink named John Spittal as Chief Topographer/Hydrographer in May 1999 when it reported completion of the national topographic digital database. The programme had begun in 1995 under DOSLI, covered material published on 330 topographic sheets at 1:50,000 and produced a national dataset of about 12 GB.

Spittal described how the database could replace fixed paper-map production with one structured digital geographic record that could be queried for mapping and analysis. The newsletter establishes a senior technical spokesperson role at LINZ but does not name him as the individual programmer or data-capture operator.
